item.title: 👀 Replit is on the mend. Don't get comfortable yet.
item.description:
Some users are unable to publish apps with an external DATABASE_URL error

Impact: minor · Status: monitoring · Opened: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 18:41:09 +0000

[Monitoring] Production data is confirmed to be safe after a configuration error during deploys that impacted users on September 1st, 2026. The issue has been resolved going forward and we are working on a fix to restore impacted projects. If your project was impacted by this error please reach out to support.
